violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the prep/packaging area was lacking paper towels. PIC replaced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

Inspector observed ROP frozen cooked lobster without proper labeling. Per interview with PIC, establishment receives item from Ferry Wharf Fish Market. Per RIDOH-CFP, establishment does not have HACCP plan for ROPing cooked lobster. Items were embargoed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

Seaweed salad was observed sold outside of original packaging and did not contain labels. PIC made label for items. Seafood stuffing from Ferry Wharf Fish Market was lacking complete label (undeclared allergens and lacks subingredients, manufacture information, and net weight). Item was embargoed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026
Frozen items were observed stored on the floor in the basement walk-in freezer. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2024

The utensils (tongs and spoons) are stored on an unclean surface (rack inside display coolers) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

The cutting boards in the seafood prep area are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

The condensate from the retail chest freezers, ice bins, and seafood display cooler unit are draining into containers. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/25/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2025

The walk-in cooler fan cover has an accumulation of soil residue. The basement and seafood department floors were observed with puddles. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026
